chunks: About a man whom another man called while he was praying, so he became distracted and responded to him regarding his need—what should he do? He said: “He should continue with his salat (prayer).”
ai.seo_question: If someone responds to a person while distracted during salat (prayer), should he continue the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who is distracted during salat (prayer) and responds to someone calling him. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he should continue his salat (prayer), indicating that such an occurrence does not require him to abandon it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1565 - Uqbah ibn Khalid asked Him (Imam Abu Abdullah (as))

about a man who was praying and another man called out to him, causing him to become distracted and respond to the person's request. What should he do?
Imam (as) said: "He should continue with his prayer."
